business_summary: Zijin Longking Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells environmental protection equipment worldwide. It operates through two segments: Environmental Protection and New Energy. The company offers products and solutions for environmental protection; air pollution control; water pollution control; solid waste treatment; waste incineration power; and generation and hazardous waste disposal, as well as soil pollution control and remediation services; power generation, power transmission, power supply, and battery sales; and manufacturing of mining machinery and equipment. It also engages in the property management; consulting; trading; testing; industrial investment; technical; waste incineration; household waste disposal; comprehensive water utilization; hazardous waste and solid waste treatment; water treatment; technology promotion and application; ecological protection and environmental governance; electricity and heat production and supply; energy storage technology; electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing; battery manufacturing and sales; specialized equipment research and development, manufacturing, and sales; construction and maintenance of hydropower stations; and electricity production, transmission, distribution, and sales business. The company exports its products to Russia, Kazakhstan, Indonesia, and other countries. The company was formerly known as Fujian Longking Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zijin Longking Co., Ltd. in August 2026. Zijin Longking Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is based in Longyan, China.
